name: T3 Code
author: DigitalPals
description: Watch and steer your T3 Code agents from the menubar. Signs in to T3 Connect, shows how many sessions are running or waiting for you, and opens a panel to read threads, answer approvals and questions, start new threads, and settle, snooze or pin work.

barWidget.description: T3 Code sessions through T3 Connect: a status chip with running and waiting counts, and a panel to follow and answer threads.

schema.label: Status label
schema.description: Show the waiting/running word on the chip. It is also hidden when the widget's width leaves no room for it.
